results.explanation: source_supported_failure: At the declared entry, a verified non-admin is bound to the supplied file through a user-scoped file lookup, but the visible authorization control checks only file ownership. The caller-supplied collection name is retained as the destination and passed to the vector-write helper with add enabled; no destination ownership or write-grant check is visible before the write. The protected effect is insertion of the processed file items into that named collection. Thus, under the stated premises, source-visible behavior permits the attempted destination write, although the accepted policy requires denial because source-file ownership is distinct from destination knowledge-base write permission. The destination write sink is the vector database insertion. No decisive source-external fact is required at the declared-entry boundary; actual deployment/database success is outside the supplied source boundary and is not inferred.
